subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session initialization own permanent conflict recovery while Discord retains this bounded retry as defense in depth, or should recovery live at only one layer?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 recover the same conflict at different ownership layers; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended combined retry, teardown, and replay policy.

options.title: Shared recovery plus bounded Discord retry
options.body: Use the shared self-heal as canonical and retain this narrow abort-aware Discord retry after adding combined-layer coverage.

options.title: Shared recovery only
options.body: Pause this PR and land the shared-session recovery if maintainers want one centralized policy without channel-specific retries.

options.title: Discord recovery only
options.body: Land this PR as the complete Discord policy and decline the shared self-heal for this failure mode.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus bounded Discord retry
recommendation.body: Use the shared self-heal as canonical and retain this narrow abort-aware Discord retry after adding combined-layer coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigned this person and recent history spans both the Discord handler and shared session-lifecycle surface involved in the choice.
